result.question: How did Paul learn about the plan?

readings.support: the son of Paul’s sister heard about the plot | told Paul

assessments.reason: Acts 23:16 states “the son of Paul’s sister … told Paul,” which is Paul’s nephew; this matches the key’s “Nephew heard and told him.”

result.reason: The verse explicitly says Paul learned of the plan because his sister’s son (his nephew) heard the plot and told him.
